p: The ad opens with kinetic text questioning who reviews agent-written specs over a faded document background. It demonstrates highlighting text in a web doc, leaving a comment requesting a 3-week version, running a CLI command to apply feedback via Claude, and showing the updated spec document with the resolved comment thread. It finishes on a CTA card.
Artifact Share lets teams review and comment directly on AI-generated design docs, allowing AI agents to automatically apply revisions and update the artifact at the same URL.

[{"timestamp":"00:00","observation":"Kinetic text hook begins overlaid on a faded spec doc."},{"timestamp":"00:05","observation":"Cursor selects text and opens the comment modal."},{"timestamp":"00:11","observation":"Fast cut to terminal showing CLI agent execution to apply feedback."},{"timestamp":"00:17","observation":"Updated spec renders with resolved thread verified."},{"timestamp":"00:23","observation":"End screen displays core value proposition and artifactshare.com CTA."}]

The pacing effectively conveys the review loop between humans and AI agents without visual clutter. The UI typography remains sufficiently legible despite feed scaling. Audio cues and visual transitions match the workflow cleanly.

p: ["hook frame is a dense doc screenshot with small caption text, low motion/visual punch to stop a scroll","final CTA button renders as light-gray-on-white with low-contrast white text, easy to misread as a disabled/placeholder element","mostly static screenshots; visual quality relies on UI cleanliness rather than cinematography"]

The ad does a good job walking through the actual product loop (comment on doc → agent edits via CLI → republish → decision made), which makes product and message clarity strong and directly on-brief. But the opening frame is a busy screenshot rather than a punchy hook, so scroll-stopping power is weak for a fast X feed. The CTA button's low-contrast styling undercuts an otherwise clear final message and could read as broken or inactive rather than clickable.
